summary: Quantum-Si Inc filed an 8-K to disclose a lease agreement for office, lab, and manufacturing space in San Diego, California. The 10-year lease, effective June 18, 2026, covers 54,374 square feet with initial monthly base rent of $315,369, increasing 3% annually, and includes 20 months of rent abatement and a $17.1 million tenant improvement allowance. This is a routine operational real estate transaction in connection with a planned facility transition, not a special situation event. No watch/arb angle.
